data: Which of the following distributions is present in the figure?

The figure shows a comparison of different distributions: Power law, Log-normal, Truncated power law, and Exponential. The caption mentions that the equation above the upper plot represents the coefficients of a power law distribution. The lower plot shows the probability distribution function P(k) = Pr(k ≥ k), where k is the hypernym count. The Xmin is marked on the lower plot, indicating the point at which notable differences in hypernym counts are observed. The figure also includes a raw data line, which represents the actual data points. Based on the caption and the visual elements, the Power law distribution is present in the figure.
